summary: This companion verification preprint provides an independent, zero-float certification suite (EQUIANGULAR-18-20-CERT-1.0) for the recent historic resolution of real equiangular lines in dimensions 18-20 (N(18)=57, N(19)=72, N(20)=90) by Djaljapayan, Liao, and Yu. The work formalizes 18 core theorems in Lean 4.35.0 without Mathlib and implements an AST-audited Python verifier using exact rational LDL^T factorizations across 16 canonical certificates.
weaknesses: Scope is strictly limited to companion verification; primary mathematical discovery belongs to Djaljapayan et al. (2026).
